container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the container (scancode). doom3-bfg timed out at 900 s; scancode is single-process here and scales with file count.
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (Syft/Grype/OSV/ScanCode).
